name: flow
title: Mithras Flow Board Vocabulary
description: One class per Mithras Flow table (13), typed door for the playground's resource facts.
comment: Read from tmp/mithras-flow/flow/src/db/schema.ts (DDL, source of truth for columns and order) and src/types.ts at 9ead5ee, cross-checked against courtship/flow-shapes-v1.ttl and flow-specimen.ttl. Geometry columns (systems x/y/width/height, workflows x/y, trades x/y, constraints x/y, and waypoints on the four link tables — the 14 fields interfaces.md §C names) live in the board Y.Doc's scene root, never here; display_mode, parent_id, and sort_order ARE resource facts (interfaces.md §C) and are materialized. flow:Snapshot (a shape for the JSON file envelope, not a DB table) is out of scope — 13 classes = 13 Flow tables. See contracts/vocabulary-map.md for the full table/class/predicate map, the six RTRIP-11 corrections, and the sh:order/domain-range placement notes.

Constraint.comment: Parametric constraint / external driver (SysML constraint block) - mission, regulatory, equation; owns its requirements (ConstraintNode.tsx:6-8). x, y are scene geometry and are NOT materialized on this class.

flow:description.source: constraints.description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; the characteristic/equation, markdown; a legacy calc_url folds into a Source row at parse time if none exists (persistence.ts:86-92)

ConstraintLink.comment: Target is a system OR a requirement (types.ts:111), with a note. waypoints is scene geometry and is NOT materialized on this class.

flow:constraint.source: constraint_links.constraint_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:Constraint

flow:target.source: constraint_links.target_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:or(System,Requirement) in raw_shacl_shapes

Dependency.comment: Schedule predecessor/successor between tasks or requirements (types.ts:118). This pack materializes the literal DDL columns flow:predecessor/flow:successor directly and does NOT include the derived flow:dependsOn shortcut (see contracts/vocabulary-map.md, RTRIP-11 correction #6, for why: flow:dependsOn is not a DDL column, and this unit could not reproduce the R1 paper's claimed direction inversion against schedule.ts).

flow:predecessor.source: deps.predecessor_id TEXT NOT NULL; task or requirement id; sh:or(Task,Requirement) in raw_shacl_shapes

flow:successor.source: deps.successor_id TEXT NOT NULL; task or requirement id; sh:or(Task,Requirement) in raw_shacl_shapes

Edge.comment: Free labeled edge; target may be a requirement row. waypoints is scene geometry and is NOT materialized on this class.

flow:sourceNode.source: edges.source_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:or(System,Workflow,Trade,Constraint) in raw_shacl_shapes

flow:targetNode.source: edges.target_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:or(System,Workflow,Trade,Constraint,Requirement) in raw_shacl_shapes; toFlow.ts endpoint(): a requirement target anchors on its owner's row handle

Outcome.comment: What a workflow is meant to produce: a measurement, dataset, decision, artifact (types.ts:51).

flow:workflow.source: outcomes.workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:Workflow

flow:achieved.source: outcomes.achieved BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false

Requirement.comment: Owner: a system, constraint, or trade (types.ts:20; UUIDs unique across tables, no DB FK). RTRIP-11 correction #1: the requirement's evidence citation is flow:requirementSource, NOT flow:source (avoids the flow:source/flow:Source case collision the R1 paper found).

flow:ownedBy.source: requirements.system_id TEXT NOT NULL; owner is System|Constraint|Trade (sh:or in raw_shacl_shapes)

flow:requirementSource.source: requirements.source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; markdown citation, e.g. 'ICD 4.2' (RENAMED from flow:source, RTRIP-11 #1)

flow:status.source: requirements.status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'; types.ts ReqStatus = 'open'|'met'|'waived'

Source.comment: A reference (datasheet, calculator spreadsheet, doc) owned by a system, workflow, constraint, OR TRADE — types.ts:101-103 says only system|workflow|constraint, but TradeDetails renders SourcesList for trades (DetailsPanel.tsx:121) and deleteTradeCascade deletes trade-owned sources (repo.ts:473): the code wins, the shape follows the code (per this unit's brief: 'where the shapes and the DDL disagree, the DDL wins' — here it is the STALE COMMENT in types.ts that disagrees with the code, and the code is the tighter authority than its own comment). RTRIP-11 correction #2: this row's own citation text is flow:sourceCitation, NOT the shared flow:text (avoids flow:text over-collapsing a Source's reference with a Requirement's/Task's/Outcome's statement).

flow:ownedBy.source: sources.owner_id TEXT NOT NULL; owner is System|Workflow|Constraint|Trade (sh:or in raw_shacl_shapes)

flow:sourceCitation.source: sources.text TEXT NOT NULL; markdown, e.g. '[thrust calc](https://...)' (RENAMED from flow:text, RTRIP-11 #2)

System.comment: Nested via parent_id; groups carry explicit width/height (geometry, excluded here), leaves auto-size; display_mode solid = concrete system, outline = meta context (DetailsPanel.tsx:153). x, y, width, height are scene geometry (interfaces.md §C) and are NOT materialized on this class.

flow:displayMode.source: systems.display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'solid'; types.ts DisplayMode = 'solid'|'outline'

flow:color.source: systems.color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#111111'; UI emits #rrggbb, the app never validates (Warning-severity pattern)

Task.comment: Owned by a system or a workflow, discriminated by owner_type (types.ts:3 OwnerType).

flow:ownedBy.source: tasks.owner_id TEXT NOT NULL; owner is System|Workflow per owner_type (sh:or + sh:sparql cross-check in raw_shacl_shapes)

flow:done.source: tasks.done BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false

Trade.comment: Candidate systems evaluated against metrics; winner declared by judgment (types.ts:76). RTRIP-11 correction #3: the decision rationale is flow:tradeRationale, NOT the shared flow:description (FLOW-ATTR-1 names 'trade description as rationale' as one of the three attributed-witness predicates; giving it its own CURIE makes that attribution boundary exact instead of riding the generic description property systems/workflows/constraints also use). x, y are scene geometry and are NOT materialized on this class.

flow:tradeRationale.source: trades.description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; 'rationale lives here once decided' (types.ts:79) (RENAMED from flow:description, RTRIP-11 #3)

flow:winner.source: trades.winner_id TEXT nullable; sh:class flow:System AND sh:sparql 'winner must be a linked TradeLink candidate' in raw_shacl_shapes

TradeLink.comment: A candidate under evaluation. waypoints is scene geometry (interfaces.md §C) and is NOT materialized on this class.

flow:trade.source: trade_links.trade_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:Trade

flow:system.source: trade_links.system_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:System

Workflow.comment: x, y are scene geometry (interfaces.md §C) and are NOT materialized on this class.

flow:description.source: workflows.description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; a legacy 'purpose' enum folds in here at parse time (persistence.ts:78-84)

WorkflowLink.comment: workflow <-> system with a role and user-adjusted waypoints. waypoints is scene geometry (interfaces.md §C) and is NOT materialized on this class.

flow:workflow.source: workflow_links.workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:Workflow

flow:system.source: workflow_links.system_id TEXT NOT NULL; sh:class flow:System

registration.comment: G1 registration testimony (Mithras Flow playground build, lane G unit 1).
registration.embedded_bytes: FLOW_GOLDEN_JSON = include_str!("vocabs/flow.golden.json") - served byte-verbatim, never re-serialized
registration.sha_constant: FLOW_GOLDEN_SHA = sha256 of the on-disk golden bytes (recompute with: shasum -a 256 src/emporium/vocabs/flow.golden.json), pinned at land time
invariants: registry name equals this golden's 'name' field exactly (registry_names_match_golden_names)
internal-substrate, not a public ontology pillar — mirrors shrubbery-site's own non-pillar status (vocabs.rs jurisdiction comment)
geometry (x, y, width, height, waypoints — 14 fields per interfaces.md §C) is deliberately absent from every class's predicates; it lives in the board Y.Doc's scene root, not :projection:flow
version bump = new golden + new sha; the served body is the embedded bytes verbatim
